data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Contradiction (Prospective Normativity vs. Retrospective Fitness). The problem stands in contradiction to the neighbourhood's evolutionary analogies by asserting that scientific preference inherently requires a prospective normative commitment (belief in future reliability) that biological evolution explicitly rejects as teleological. Refuted If: It is shown that scientists can and do prefer corroborated theories purely as strategic tools for error elimination without any underlying belief in their future truth or reliability, thereby aligning scientific preference perfectly with blind biological selection.
